name: SVG Editor
description: View local SVG diagrams and edit their source with a safe live preview, zoom, pan and recoverable drafts.

open.help: Open a local SVG file; refuses to replace unsaved edits

state.help: Current SVG source, saved source, unsaved state and recoverable drafts

edit.help: Update source and persist a draft; revision must increase

save.help: Save source; path chooses a new destination and refuses overwrite

newDocument.help: Start a simple architecture diagram; refuses unsaved edits

discard.help: Explicitly discard edits and return to the last saved source

recover.help: Recover a saved draft by its id
